name: experimental_qk_head256_chunk16_nr1_bf16_v1
production_default: fp32_rmsnorm256_chunked.QK_CANDIDATE=0 retains legacy direct-weight FP32 behavior; candidate wrapper explicitly selects 1
source: Default: freshly execute the immutable Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B layer3 official implementation after the real embedding/GDN0/1/2 prefix, in baseline and AVX2 CPU dispatch subprocesses; record new provenance. Optional historical replay accepts only locally supplied immutable original archives.
boundary: same-input component oracle only: native projected Q/K inputs; this is not independently accumulated Matrix output or full-block evidence
geometry: hidden1024; packed q_proj4096 = eight consecutive [Q256,gate256] groups; Q width2048, K2*256=512
input_layout: One head: packed_i low4096bits contains256 BF16 arithmetic words, high4096 contains256 raw gate words. Word0 is low16bits. Q role0 returns gate raw; K role1 ignores padding and returns zero gate
descriptor: Only policy0xc1, roles0/1, head_dim256, epsilon0x358637bd accepted. Bad descriptors produce status1
arithmetic_domain: Input arithmetic BF16 x and raw weight each allow signedzero or normal exponent95..158 inclusive. Nonfinite produces status2; other finite encodings status3. Raw gates/padding accept every16bit pattern and never contribute arithmetic flags
gamma: Actual RTL RN32(1.0 + BF16 weight promoted exactly toFP32); gamma remainsFP32
reduction: RN32 squares; sixteen adjacent chunks each have balanced16 pairwise tree with RN32 at each node; chunk sums serially RN32 accumulated from+0 in ascending chunk order
inverse: Existing literal fp32_rsqrt_coeffs.svh PWL table and fp32_rsqrt_nr exact one-Newton separatedFP32 operations. Not sqrt+divide, not twoNewton, noFMA
output: RN32(RN32(x*inverse)*gamma), then fp32_to_bf16_rne_candidate conversion toactual16bit BF16
flags: OR every performed square/tree/running/mean/epsilon/rsqrt/gamma/output/conversion flag. Candidate captures mean/epsilon flags with mean_eps_q. NV,DZ,OF,UF,NX inbits4..0. Unsupported rsqrt-domain, unexpected nonfinite result, or any NV/DZ/OF/UF flag returns status4 with zero data. Preflight errors have zero flags/debug; runtime errors retain observed flags/debug
ownership: Single outstanding accepted valid&&ready transaction; capture descriptor,tag,operands,rawgate. No accept whilebusy. All result data/status/tag/flags/debug scalars stable under output backpressure
reset: Active-low reset held acrossatleast2risingedges flushes work and counters. No external no-ID fabric is attached atthis component boundary
completion: Result valid&&ready only; no memory store,DDR acknowledgement,Command128 or genericSFU owner completion
threshold_source: spec/numerical_contract.md unchanged: each source/phase/Q-or-K group max_abs<=0.03125 and mean_abs<=0.005. Exact candidate RTL versus independent integer/C oracle required separately.
artifact_policy: Download pinned byte ranges and convert transiently under work/. No model weights or reconstructed NumPy corpora in Git; publish only source, pins and allowlisted summaries. Historical CPU byte identity is never claimed for fresh execution.
